title: Domestic strategic capacity has multiple clocks before autonomy or leverage
source_unit: Deliberately non-pooled comparison of US critical-mineral, CHIPS, data-center/grid, and JASSM/LRASM realization records
geography: United States and named partner/procurement contexts

denominator.unit: minerals designated critical in the cited US framework; selected application evidence has separate units

selected_materials_with_100_percent_net_.unit: selected materials named by USGS, not all critical minerals

china_major_source_count.unit: of 33 critical minerals on which the US most depends

observations.method: GAO technology assessment and USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries as preserved in the local critical-minerals layer.
observations.uncertainty: Import reliance is not a cutoff or harm measure; recycling and substitution potential are not realized output or supplier switching.
observations.counterinterpretation: A concentrated source can remain commercially reliable, and an alternative may exist for one application but not another.

observations.method: GAO review of Commerce semiconductor incentives, milestones, workforce activity, and R&D governance.
observations.uncertainty: Disbursement and milestones do not establish yield, customer delivery, worker retention, or reduced import dependence.
observations.subgroup: Commerce-funded semiconductor, materials, packaging, and R&D projects.
observations.counterinterpretation: A milestone may represent genuine capability progress even when public output and strategic substitution remain unmeasured.

observations.period: 2023-2026; US data-center/grid realization and governance records

denominator.unit: non-pooled national, county, utility-event, and governance record set

observations.method: Retained LBNL, county, Virginia governance, and utility-event ledgers.
observations.uncertainty: National estimates, local aggregates, and utility events cannot establish facility-level compute, household incidence, ownership, or replaceability.
observations.subgroup: US data-center electricity and Virginia large-load systems.
observations.counterinterpretation: Capacity and fiscal revenue can coexist with useful services; observed load drops do not by themselves establish lasting reliability harm.

denominator.unit: non-pooled US award, facility, test, and Polish order record set

observations.method: Retained USAspending, facility, production-support, testing, Polish official, and realization-stage records.
observations.uncertainty: A planned window, broad delivery list, or test does not establish shipment, acceptance, fielding, inventory, or external response for a specific order.
observations.subgroup: JASSM/LRASM US production/control surface and Poland JASSM-ER order.
observations.counterinterpretation: Public non-observation is not proof of non-delivery; procurement and physical realization can run on asynchronous clocks.

related_sources.claim: CHIPS awards, disbursements, milestones, workforce, and governance boundaries.
Mineral import reliance, processing concentration, substitution, and recycling boundaries.
Data-center capacity, governance, load events, and missing realized-capability joins.
Cross-case realization-stage audit for data centers and JASSM-ER.

boundary: This deliberately non-pooled synthesis distinguishes commitment, capacity, operation, replaceability, and leverage. It does not estimate domestic autonomy, causal investment effects, household incidence, supplier-switching rates, or geopolitical leverage. Identifier-bearing production, acceptance, customer use, substitute qualification, or external response remains the next decisive evidence.
